stories.title: Wire the F-092/097/111 card emitters to EXECUTE + write state (carousel data-starvation root fix)
acceptance: PRE-FLIGHT baseline: on the Pi confirm /run/eclipse-obd/states/ holds only boot-state; NOTE the phantom-CE seen earlier was STALE deployed carousel.js (deploy drift), already resolved by the V0.29.14 redeploy -- the Pi's /opt/dashboard/carousel.js now matches dev (honest code hides the takeover when no code). So this story measures EMITTER WIRING, not the phantom-CE artifact (Atlas gap-close).

ATLAS Q-1 RUN-MODEL (load-bearing): system-status + dtc emitters are ORCHESTRATOR-INVOKED from the process owning the single ObdConnection (feed them from the same serialized query() the US-404 KOEO read uses); do NOT add standalone systemd units that open their own OBD connection. boot-state stays its own unit (pre-orchestrator, no OBD). battery-health reads UPS/I2C (MAX17048) not the OBD port -> standalone is safe but prefer in-process for cadence coherence (Ralph's mechanism call; hard constraint = nothing touching the OBD port opens its own connection).

ATLAS idle-SSOT (b): the system-status emitter WRITES an explicit boolean `idle: true|false` (it owns both inputs obd.available + driveState) -- do NOT leave idle display-derived (that's the DELTA-1 consumer-arbitrates pattern). US-481 consumes this flag.

on the Pi, the states dir contains system-status + battery-health + dtc files, freshly written + refreshing on cadence; eclipse-states-http serves them (HTTP 200 + non-empty JSON); cards render REAL values (not 'unavailable')
the dtc emitter writes an honest empty/absent state when no code + no key-on read (verify the takeover stays hidden on the CURRENT Pi assets -- confirms we're measuring wiring, not stale-asset drift)
Typecheck + pi tests green for this slice

stories.goal: As the deployed carousel, I want the system-status / battery-health / dtc emitters to actually RUN and write their state files on the Pi, so the cards render live data instead of the current NA/unavailable wall (states dir holds ONLY boot-state -- PM-verified). On 1920x1080 the HEIGHT binds -> 3.375x, clean black bars left+right.
